result.reason: The added insurance paragraph fully implements the preferred position and therefore also exceeds the fallback limits. It correctly identifies Kubient as the obligated party, imposes coverage throughout the Term, includes the Customer-data trigger, and directs certificates to Customer on request. It is not strictly minimal because the rendered clause unnecessarily relocates existing subsection (iii) ahead of the Section 14 heading and subsection (i), creating awkward numbering and organization. The existing operative language is otherwise retained without contradiction.
